DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease) caused by Parvovirus B19.

The combination of a "slapped cheek" facial rash sparing the perioral area and a lacy, reticular rash on the trunk and extremities, along with your prodromal symptoms of fever and headache, is pathognomonic for this condition. The negative Monospot test helps rule out Mono, and the specific rash morphology confirms the viral etiology.
